motivation.precedent: Notebook 59 found that the unchanged Notebook 36 long leg supplied 97.4% of total arithmetic gross contribution
motivation.timing: post-result mechanism diagnostic on an opened historical window
motivation.question: Does the selected long leg beat same-date market and same-sector exposure controls, or is its gross result explained by broad or sector exposure?

candidate.precedent: Notebook 36 equal-weight Gemma-event-timing and FinBERT-ranking hybrid
candidate.universe: immutable original LSEG sector-33, three companies in each of 11 sectors
candidate.selected_long_weights: positive Notebook 36 target weights only; dates, counts, names, and weights unchanged
candidate.return_horizon: same one-session open-to-open price return as Notebook 36
candidate.price_convention: split-adjusted price returns; dividends not back-adjusted

controls.equal_weight_market: on each session, distribute the selected long leg's total positive target weight equally across all 33 original companies
controls.same_sector_equal_weight: on each session and within each sector, distribute the selected long leg's sector-level positive target weight equally across all three original sector members
matching: same sector exposures for the same-sector control
controls.cost_treatment: gross contributions only; no control turnover, trading cost, or net strategy is constructed

estimands: mean selected-long minus equal-weight-market gross contribution per complete session
mean selected-long minus same-sector-equal-weight gross contribution per complete session
inference.positive_gate: difference mean is positive and BH-adjusted null is rejected

mechanism_classification.both: selected long passes both the market and same-sector positive gates
mechanism_classification.market_only: selected long passes only the market positive gate
mechanism_classification.sector_only: selected long passes only the same-sector positive gate
mechanism_classification.neither: selected long passes neither positive gate
